scope.release_unit: one scheduled run_id and its assigned arm

gates.command: uv run ruff check scripts/preflight_assets.py tests/test_preflight_assets.py

adversarial_findings.finding: Opening a directory descriptor with os.fdopen failed during release.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Reproduced, changed to dir_fd operations, and covered by real N/S/T CLI tests.

adversarial_findings.finding: A visible asset changed after its first hash could be copied.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Copied bytes are rehashed and compared before the final manifest; a failed release leaves no valid manifest.

adversarial_findings.finding: A hidden reference changed after its first hash could go unnoticed at manifest time.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Hidden references and rubric are reopened and rehashed just before the manifest. This remains a point-in-time check.

adversarial_findings.finding: A hostile process with the same UID can replace a newly created directory even under a private parent.
adversarial_findings.resolution: The script rejects a symlink or group/other-writable parent, but same-UID hostility needs a separate custodian account and access controls.

adversarial_findings.finding: Hashes do not reveal a hidden answer embedded as a fragment or paraphrase in a visible asset.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Independent human content review remains required before any reserved release.

not_performed: No sealed registry, independent custodian, or real reserved case files.
No model execution, receipt, telemetry, independent rating, or field trial.
No proof of provider access, prices, reviewer identity, or authorized resources.
